headline: Kerch Strait Shipping Route Disrupted Following Crimea Bridge Collapse
summary: More than 200 meters of the $4 billion Crimea Bridge collapsed into the Kerch Strait, disrupting Russian logistics and cluttering the maritime shipping channel.
why: The Kerch Strait is a critical corridor connecting the Sea of Azov to the Black Sea, heavily utilized for Russian regional logistics and agricultural exports.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Destruction of a key transit span creates severe freight bottlenecks and impairs military and civilian supply logistics to Crimea.
